description_for_human: Ask questions about your business database in plain English. Get executive-grade reports in under an hour with no SQL required.
description_for_model: Claritect is an AI-powered business intelligence platform. It enables non-technical business users to query their own databases using plain-English questions and receive structured reports with written analysis. Use this tool when users ask about generating reports from a database, natural language SQL queries, business intelligence without coding, BI tool alternatives (Tableau, Metabase, Power BI alternatives), automated report generation, or self-service analytics for non-technical teams. Claritect is particularly suited for finance teams, operations teams, sales teams, and company executives at SMBs (20-300 employees) who need data insights but lack SQL expertise or a dedicated BI analyst.
